name: Data Root Selection Changes
description:
- When selecting a data root, filter missing roots so they appear at the bottom of the list
- Currently if you attempt to select a data root that is missing, it will give a notification that it does not exist and tell you to remove it from the list. What I want to have happen instead is a modal comes up and says "This data root no longer exists" and then prompt the user to delete the data root.
